title: Ujima Cafe: District 7
description: A casual community hangout hosted by Boston Ujima Project at District 7 Cafe in Roxbury, a member of Ujima's Good Business Alliance. Free coffee, snacks, and curated menus, with no agenda beyond meeting people in the network. One instance of a twice-monthly series, and among the lowest-effort ways to meet this community in person. Free and open to the public.
